summary: msgpackrpc 0.1.0 exfiltrates installer host identifiers to webhook.site on install
details: The sdist's setup.py overrides the install command with a class that, during `pip install`, collects the installer's hostname via socket.gethostname() and resolves its IP via socket.gethostbyname(), then POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site collector URL (https://webhook.site/711f31ae-7091-4b68-9631-57b6c6f19980) using urllib.request.urlopen. The package ships no actual functionality: msgpackrpc/__init__.py is empty, the project metadata self-describes as a 'POC package (beacon-only)', and the author field is the placeholder 'Your Name'. The package name is a typosquat shape against the legitimate msgpack-rpc ecosystem. Installing this version causes the installer's host identifiers to leave the machine to an attacker-controlled endpoint with no disclosure or consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
